subject: ORCHESTRA MAP: Proposed acceptance tests & close timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@nexahealth.com>; NexaHealth Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: ORCHESTRA MAP: Proposed acceptance tests & close timeline

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the conversation this morning. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (sheet 'ORCHESTRA-MAP') that captures the evaluation goals, exit gates, acceptance tests, and a realistic close runway for NexaHealth's pilot of Redwood Inference.

High-level asks / acceptance buckets (short):
- Functional: generation accuracy on 10k sampled prompts >= 92% F1 for entity extraction; end-to-end latency P95 < 400ms on 8k token batch profile.
- Safety / reliability: no critical hallucination incidents in 48-hour smoke test (sampled production prompts); error rate < 0.5%.
- Security / compliance: SOC2 evidence review complete; data residency verified for EU/US segmented datasets (if applicable).
- Integration: SDK-based inference in staging for 2 full days with no more than 2 integration defects.

Exit gates (what 'pass' looks like):
1) Pass functional tests as above with evidence in the 'evidence' tab of the MAP.
2) Security checklist marked complete by NexaHealth security (owner: procurement@nexahealth.com).
3) Rollout playbook reviewed and a canary plan defined (owner: Marissa).

Proposed timeline (compressed close):
- Week 0 (Aug 24): Agree MAP + owners. (today)
- Week 1 (Aug 31): Full integration in staging + run smoke tests.
- Week 2 (Sep 7): Evidence review + security sign-off.
- Week 3 (Sep 14): Executive sign-off and go/no-go; production cutover if green.

Attachments: NexaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with tasks/owners), SLA-draft-2026.pdf (baseline SLA + escalation path).

Two asks for you:
1) Confirm who will own security evidence and the expected timeline for the SOC2 desk review.
2) Confirm that the latency target above (P95 < 400ms) is acceptable; if not, propose a target.

If that all looks OK I suggest a 30-min sync Thu (Aug 26) to lock owners and milestone dates. Please reply with availability.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference
Attachment: NexaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx), SLA-draft-2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@nexahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: NexaHealth Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-24T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: ORCHESTRA MAP: Proposed acceptance tests & close timeline

Karthik,

Thanks — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Security owner: Procurement will coordinate the SOC2 desk review but our security lead (Michael Chan) must be looped. Can you add Michael (michael.chan@nexahealth.com) to the MAP and add a short evidence column for 'endpoint encryption proofs'?
- Latency: P95 < 400ms looks aggressive for our payloads (we often hit long prompts). Can we have a two-tier acceptance: P95 < 600ms for mixed production samples, and a target P95 < 450ms for optimized prompt sets (bonus pass)?
- Timeline: We need an extra week for internal security sign-off — can we shift 'Week 2' to Sep 14 and executive sign-off to Sep 21?

Procurement note (cc'ed): we'll review the SLA-draft and come back with redlines. For the Thu sync, I have 10:30–11:00 PT and after 16:00 PT open. Thu is Aug 26th — either slot works.

Thanks,

Ava Roberts
VP Product
NexaHealth
ava.roberts@nexahealth.com

- Latency gating: P95 < 600ms (mixed samples) required; P95 < 450ms (optimized prompt set) = bonus pass and will be captured as a secondary gate.
- Timeline shift accepted: internal security sign-off moved to 2026-09-14; exec sign-off to 2026-09-21; production cutover target 2026-09-28.

Owners and immediate next actions:
- Procurement (procurement@nexahealth.com): SLA redlines (due Sep 2).
- Marissa Cole: run and document 48-hour smoke test in staging (starts Sep 1).
- Ben Carter: prepare canary rollback playbook (draft due Sep 9).

Scheduled: Thu Aug 26 10:30 PT — confirmed. I'll send calendar invite with agenda (MAP owners, evidence checklist, and go/no-go rubric).

If anyone needs to propose alternate dates, reply all.
